response.answer: For constrained teams, low-cost Docker+Snakemake runs can use AWS t2.micro instances with EBS storage, or Google Compute Engine's f1-micro instances. Both offer minimal cost and sufficient resources for small-scale workflows.

results.title: Neuroscience Cloud Analysis As a Service: An open- ...
results.content: # NeuroResource Neuroscience Cloud Analysis As a Service: An open-source platform for scalable, reproducible data analysis. The NeuroCAAS platform provides reproducible data analysis infrastructure at scale. Popular data analyses adapted to NeuroCAAS are faster and cheaper than alternatives. A key aspect of neuroscience research is the development of powerful, general-purpose data analyses that process large datasets. Unfortunately, modern data analyses have a hidden dependence upon complex computing infrastructure (e.g., software and hardware), which acts as an unaddressed deterrent to analysis users. In this work, we develop Neuroscience Cloud Analysis As a Service (NeuroCAAS): a fully automated open-source analysis platform offering automatic infrastructure reproducibility for any data analysis. We show how NeuroCAAS supports the design of simpler, more powerful data analyses and that many popular data analysis tools offered through NeuroCAAS outperform counterparts on typical infrastructure. Pairing rigorous infrastructure management with cloud resources, NeuroCAAS dramatically accelerates the dissemination and use of new data analyses for neuroscientific discovery. This paper analyzes existing, publicly available data.
